Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta

Class BrainRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.BrainRegistry
public class BrainRegistry extends Object
Central registry that owns every MannequinBrain currently active in the server.

Responsibilities

  • Maps Mannequin UUID → MannequinBrain.
  • Persists brain configuration (goal / sensor keys + priorities) to the mannequin's PersistentDataContainer so it survives restarts.
  • Restores persisted brains on server start by scanning loaded mannequins and calling the registered GoalFactory / SensorFactory.

Quick-start


 // --- In your plugin's onEnable ---
 BrainRegistry registry = new BrainRegistry(this);

 // Register factories so the registry can reconstruct goals/sensors from PDC keys.
 registry.getGoalFactory().register(LookAtPlayerGoal.KEY, (mannequin, plugin) -> new LookAtPlayerGoal());
 registry.getSensorFactory().register(NearestPlayerSensor.KEY, (mannequin, plugin) -> new NearestPlayerSensor(plugin, 16.0));

 // Restore brains for every mannequin already loaded (called once at startup).
 registry.restoreAll();

 // --- Later: create a new brain for a freshly spawned mannequin ---
 MannequinBrain brain = registry.getOrCreate(mannequin);
 brain.getNormalSelector().addGoal(1, LookAtPlayerGoal.KEY, new LookAtPlayerGoal());
 brain.getSensorSelector().addSensor(mannequin, NearestPlayerSensor.KEY, new NearestPlayerSensor(plugin, 16.0));
 brain.start();

 // --- In your plugin's onDisable ---
 registry.shutdownAll();

Thread safety

The registry map is a ConcurrentHashMap; however, MannequinBrain methods must still be called from the main server thread (they schedule Bukkit tasks).

    • remove

      public void remove(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Shuts down the brain for mannequin and removes it from the registry. The brain's PDC data is left intact on the mannequin so it can be restored later.
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin whose brain should be removed

    • save

      public void save(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Persists all goal and sensor keys for mannequin's brain to its PersistentDataContainer.

      Called automatically by MannequinBrain whenever goals or sensors are added/removed via the selector wrappers, but you can also call it explicitly before a chunk unloads.

      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin whose brain state should be saved

    • saveAll

      public void saveAll()
      Persists every registered brain to its mannequin's PDC. Call this from onDisable before the worlds save.

    • restore

      public MannequinBrain restore(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Restores a brain for mannequin from its PDC, using the registered GoalFactory and SensorFactory to rebuild goal/sensor instances.

      Goals or sensors whose key has no registered factory are skipped with a warning logged.

      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin to restore
      Returns:
      the restored (and started) brain, or null if the mannequin had no persisted brain data

    • restoreAll

      public int restoreAll()
      Scans all loaded worlds for mannequins that have persisted brain data and calls restore(Mannequin) for each one.

      Call once during onEnable, after registering all factories.

      Returns:
      the number of brains successfully restored

    • shutdownAll

      public void shutdownAll()
      Saves all brains to PDC, then shuts every brain down and clears the registry. Call from onDisable.
